name: OSF World Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: OSF's top belt began on a Sunday Night Slam, when OSW's owner made the International Championship the OSF World Title and named its holder, the 500-pound Kimbusa, its first champion. Tempest was champion by May 2003 and retained against Akage Kitagami on 4 June; Inphino Blitz was champion by October and defended against Kenyatta Jackson at B3.
notes: Dated from OSF's own Title History and Champions pages and its news, columns and recaps; the title-change nights between the three reigns are not recorded.
